critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1490-1493 fix is correct — uses isinstance dict check before .get() so any malformed journey_cache doc (no from/to, or non-dict) is now skipped instead of crashing. Good defensive coding.

server.py:1760-1783 deferred bg import is well-structured: 5s sleep gives readiness probe time to pass; idempotent (skips if >=1000 docs already imported); wrapped in try/except so a network blip during CSV fetch never breaks startup. Solid K8s-ready pattern.
Minor: still using deprecated @app.on_event('startup') (FastAPI ≥0.93 prefers lifespan context manager). Carry-over from iter_6 review — non-blocking.
